response.text:
I don’t have access to your landing-page image. I can’t edit it until you upload the original file (or provide a direct-download link).

Please upload the hero photo and tell me:
- Preferred mobile crop/aspect ratio or exact pixels (recommended: 9:16, e.g. 1080×1920 or 1125×2436).
- Output format (JPEG or PNG).
- How strong a change you want for the sky (brief: “slightly deeper,” “much deeper,” or a hex color like #0A4DA2).

Once you upload the image I’ll deepen the sky to the specified blue and return a tall/mobile-cropped image file.
